fusions.name: Saddle Javelin
fusions.desc: A javelin thrown from the saddle that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

fusions.name: Loosed at the Gallop
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Rein
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
